item.description:
Weekly Newsletter #51 · November 17, 2026

5th Square Advocacy is an urbanist organization of grassroots advocates building a coalition for better transportation, housing, and public space in Philadelphia. Thanks to our growing network of sustaining members for making this work possible.

🎉 TRANSIT & HOUSING WIN

🏆 URBANIST AWARD NOMINATIONS DUE FRIDAY

🛠️ FIX THE SOUTH STREET BRIDGE

🌉 SRT SWING BRIDGE NOW OPEN

🏘️ VACANT LOT -> 27 HOMES

🚇 TOMORROW: SEPTA ACCELERATE WEBINAR

🚲 TAKE ACTION FOR PARKING-PROTECTED BIKE LANES

🎅 HOLIDAY PARTY NEXT MONTH

📰 5TH SQUARE IN THE NEWS

👋 BECOME A MEMBER

Thank you to everyone who has already joined as a member! Our members fuel our grassroots work for a more accessible, sustainable, and equitable Philadelphia.

BECOME A MEMBER

🚨 ACTION ITEMS

✍️ PHILADELPHIA2050 Survey

The Philadelphia City Planning Commission's Philadelphia2050 plan will shape the future of housing, transportation, and public spaces in our city. Take their survey here and show your support for more housing, safer streets, and better public spaces!

 

🚗💨 DON'T LOWER FINES FOR RECKLESS DRIVERS

Council Bill 260699 would weaken our city's lifesaving speed camera program by cutting speed camera fines, even for reckless drivers going 30+ mph over the speed limit--tell Council: Say NO to Bill 260699!

📅 EVENTS

Nov 17

Transit Access Fund Hearing

1:00 to 3:00 PM, meet at 12:30 PM · City Hall

Give public comment during the Transit Access Fund Hearing. Be sure to bring your ID.
Nov 18

SEPTA Virtual Accelerate Transit Talk

6:00 to 7:00 PM · Virtual via Zoom

Join SEPTA for a virtual Transit Talk to learn about Accelerate, how SEPTA develops and evaluates service changes, and proposed updates to that process.
Nov 21

Housing Justice Film Series

1:00 to 2:30 PM · AAPA Temple, 6008 Germantown Ave

Join Germantown Residents for Economic Alternatives for a film screening and discussion, with free popcorn and beverages.
Nov 24

ORCA November General Meeting with OTIS

7:30 PM · Cione Recreation Center, 2600 Aramingo Ave

Olde Richmond Civic Association will be hosting OTIS to discuss improvements to Lehigh Avenue.
Dec 3

A New Day for Transit: Statewide All-Call

6:00 to 7:00 PM · Virtual

Join a statewide call of transit riders and workers to learn about the plan to grow and improve Pennsylvanians' transit, and what actions you can take to make it happen.
Dec 11

Holiday Party and Urbanist Awards Ceremony

7:00 PM · Indy Hall, 709 N 2nd St

Join us for the urbanist holiday party of the season where we'll raffle off some exciting prizes and present awards to members of our community for their outstanding contributions to Philadelphia’s urbanist movement.
Dec 12

SEPTA Holiday Bus Display

11:00 AM to 12:00 PM · Love Park

Join Transit Forward Philly as they check out the decorated buses and share ways that people can take action to support transit.
Dec 16

Transit Holiday Wishlist

9:00 AM to 5:00 PM · Transit Forward Philly Office, 1507 Walnut St #1107

All we want for the holidays is transit funding! Join Transit Forward Philly to drop off holiday wish lists at legislative offices across Philadelphia.

📖 WHAT WE'RE READING

🏙️ HOUSING & LAND USE

The Inquirer / City Council wants to make it easier to build apartments around most South Philly subway stations

The Inquirer / Walnut Street lot gutted by 2020 fire will have apartment development after all

The Inquirer / Mayor Parker’s bill to allow more homes in commercial areas hits a roadblock of community opposition

The Inquirer / One of Philly’s largest building contractors, Clemens Construction, is closing as development stagnates 

🌳 PUBLIC SPACE

Philly Mag / The Pedestrian Swing Bridge Across the Schuylkill Is Finally Opening

🚌 TRANSIT

The Inquirer / Does Harrisburg’s blue wave mean a payday for SEPTA? It’s not that simple.

PhillyVoice / 30th Street Station's South Concourse reopens as Amtrak readies to unveil new food and retail options

item.title: Newsletter: 📢 Tell Harrisburg: Fund SEPTA Accelerate / 🚉 Monday: Accelerate with SEPTA GM / 🚏 Tonight: Intercity Bus Station Meeting
item.description:
Weekly Newsletter #49 · November 04, 2026

5th Square Advocacy is an urbanist organization of grassroots advocates building a coalition for better transportation, housing, and public space in Philadelphia. Thanks to our growing network of sustaining members for making this work possible.

📢 TELL HARRISBURG: FUND SEPTA ACCELERATE

🚉 MONDAY: ACCELERATE WITH SEPTA GM

🚏 TONIGHT: INTERCITY BUS STATION MEETING

📸 SPEED CAMERA CALL-IN DAY

🕯️ WORLD DAY OF REMEMBRANCE

⏮️ SOUTH STREET MEETUP RECAP

👋 BECOME A MEMBER

Thank you to everyone who has already joined as a member! Our members fuel our grassroots work for a more accessible, sustainable, and equitable Philadelphia.

BECOME A MEMBER

🚨 ACTION ITEMS

✍️ PHILADELPHIA2050 Survey

The Philadelphia City Planning Commission's Philadelphia2050 plan will shape the future of housing, transportation, and public spaces in our city. Take their survey here and show your support for more housing, safer streets, and better public spaces!

 

🛠️ FIX THE SOUTH STREET BRIDGE

Far too many bicyclists are getting hit by cars on the South Street Bridge--tell the city to fast-track safety improvements!

 

🚗💨 DON'T LOWER FINES FOR RECKLESS DRIVERS

Council Bill 260699 would weaken our city's lifesaving speed camera program by cutting speed camera fines, even for reckless drivers going 30+ mph over the speed limit--tell Council: Say NO to Bill 260699!

 

💰🚲 SAVE FEDERAL BIKE FUNDING

DOT Secretary Sean Duffy is asking Congress to end federal funding for bike lanes and even remove existing bike lanes from roads that receive federal funding. Tell your representatives in Congress: Save Our Bike Lanes!

 

🏘️🚇 SUPPORT HOMES NEAR TRANSIT

Sign to show your support for more homes near transit! City Council passed a bill to increase housing near certain transit stations--we need your support to expand coverage to additional stations citywide.

📅 EVENTS

Nov 4

DVRPC: Transit-Oriented Development

5:30 PM · DVRPC office (190 N Independence Mall W, 8th Fl) or Zoom

DVRPC’s Public Participation Task Force is hosting a hybrid meeting about how SEPTA and NJ Transit are supporting the creation of livable and walkable places near transit stations.
Nov 4

Intercity Bus Station Open House

6:00 to 8:00 PM · Independence Visitor Center, 599 Market St

The Philadelphia City Planning Commission is hosting an open house to share the latest updates on their work to find a permanent home for Philadelphia's intercity bus station.
Nov 9

Accelerate: SEPTA’s New Vision with GM Scott Sauer

5:30 to 7:00 PM · Resurrection Philadelphia, 123 S 17th St

Join us as we host SEPTA GM Scott Sauer for a presentation on SEPTA's new Accelerate plan, followed by a Q&A. Pizza and drinks will be provided.
Nov 10

Save Speed Cameras - Call In Day

9:30 to 10:30 AM · Virtual

Join us for a virtual call in day to tell City Council that we support speed cameras and don't want to see penalties reduced for reckless driving.
Nov 10

Accelerate: SEPTA’s Best-in-Class Vision for the Authority & Region

12:00 to 1:00 PM · Virtual via Zoom

Design Advocacy Group will host SEPTA GM Scott Sauer for a virtual presentation on the agency's Accelerate plan. They'll discuss plans for new trolley and subway fleets, more frequent service, and bringing high-quality transit within reach of millions more residents and jobs.
Nov 15

World Day of Remembrance

11:00 AM · Butler Triangle (between Germantown Ave, Broad St, W Butler St)

Join us to honor those who have lost their lives or been impacted by roadway crashes. We will hear from local elected officials, city staff, community leaders, and families who have lost their loved ones to traffic violence.
Nov 21

Housing Justice Film Series

1:00 to 2:30 PM · AAPA Temple, 6008 Germantown Ave

Join Germantown Residents for Economic Alternatives for a film screening and discussion, with free popcorn and beverages.

📖 WHAT WE'RE READING

🏙️ HOUSING & LAND USE

The Inquirer / Housing prices are out of control. How much will building more homes help?
